android.desc:
Find the manual for any device you own — and keep it with you.

ManualsLib gives you access to millions of user manuals, owner's guides and service documents. Search by product name, open the document instantly, and save the ones you need to read them later without a connection.

SEARCH BY PRODUCT NAME
Type the model — “CARDIOSTRONG TR70i”, “Reloop RP8000”, “Chubbsafes Epsilon” — and see the documents available for it: user guides, installation instructions, quick start guides, spec sheets, maintenance manuals. Filter the results by document type, brand or category when a device has many.

READ WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Browsing and reading are free and unlimited, and you don't need to sign up to do it. An account is only needed for the things that belong to you: your library and your bookmarks.

SAVE TO MY MANUALS, READ OFFLINE
Save a manual and it is downloaded to your device, so it opens in the workshop, the garage or the basement where there is no signal. Downloads are encrypted on the device and are removed when you delete the manual or your account.

ORGANIZE INTO FOLDERS
Group manuals the way your life is arranged — “Smart Home”, “Home Gym”, “Music Corner”. Move documents between folders, rename folders, search inside your library.

FIND THE RIGHT PAGE
Jump through the table of contents, search inside the document text, or go straight to a page number. Bookmark the pages you keep coming back to and give them names you'll recognize — “Oil change”, “Error codes”.

SHARE AND PRINT
Send someone a link to the whole manual or to the exact page that answers their question. Print a page when paper is easier than a screen.

WORKS WITH YOUR MANUALSLIB ACCOUNT
ManualsLib has sites for several countries: manualslib.com, .de, .es, .fr and .nl. One account works across all of them, but each site keeps its own library and bookmarks, so choose your site's catalog in the app (for example, manualslib.com) to see what you saved there. Sign in with email, Google or Facebook — or delete your account and personal data from the app at any time.

Reading remains free. A single banner may appear in the manual viewer. An optional annual ManualsLib Pro subscription removes ads.
